title: Stage-1 channel attention and spatial attention are input-independent in this checkpoint
task: Step 4 Task 8 (attention / multi-scale), plus a measurement-integrity check prompted by an identical s1_ca_max column across all 11 variants

method.channel_attention: forward hook on the last nn.Linear of model.att{s}.ca.fc, i.e. the pre-sigmoid activation; sigmoid applied afterwards. Same module the shipped capture mechanism uses (iwnet/inference/capture.py:119).
method.hidden_layer: forward hook on model.att{s}.ca.fc[0] (the Linear before the ReLU).
method.spatial_attention: forward hook on model.att{s}.sa.conv, read through IntermediateTrace.spatial_attention.
method.images: 41 images = 30 uniformly sampled real training images (numpy default_rng(7)) + grape leaf.jpg + the 10 Step 4 controlled variants. For the channel-attention constant test, 51 images (40 sampled + query + 10 variants).
method.inference: unchanged production transform and unchanged production forward pass, single image, batch size 1, CPU, deterministic.

stage1_channel_attention.interpretation_limit: The pre-ReLU activation of the stage-1 hidden layer is negative for every tested input, so the hidden vector is identically zero and the output equals sigmoid(ca.fc[2].bias). This is a statement about the checkpoint's weights, not a claim about why they took those values.

stage1_spatial_attention.note: 8.0507 nats equals ln(224*224) = ln(50176), i.e. a uniform map. The stage-1 spatial map is effectively the multiplicative identity.

stage2_and_stage3_are_alive.channel_attention_hidden_relu_active: 51 of 51 images for both stage 2 and stage 3

consequence_for_task_8: Stage-1 attention statistics cannot discriminate between images because they do not vary. Any Step 4 conclusion about stage-1 channel or spatial attention must be stated as a constant, not as a per-image measurement. This does not make stage 1 information-free: model.att1.iw (the image-wise gate) and the backbone stage-1 feature itself remain input-dependent, and the stage-1 adaptive weight does vary across images and across variants (0.013326 to 0.516605).
relation_to_hypothesis_H4: Does not support H4. The stage-3 weight of the query is at the 49.87th percentile of the training distribution, and it ranges 0.472434 to 0.977998 across the controlled variants without tracking the class change. The stage-1 collapse is a separate measured training artefact and is not offered as the cause of the confirmed failure.
not_claimed: No claim that the stage-1 collapse caused the Healthy to BacterialSpot failure.
No claim about why the weights reached these values.
No claim that any attention map detected a lesion, spot or disease.
No statement that the model ignores stage 1 entirely; only that its two attention sub-modules are inert.
